condition: vehicle_type == motorcycle
action_if_failed: retain as primary evidence
rationale: Primary project universe is app-based motorcycle work.

condition: vehicle_type == car or mixed
action_if_failed: do not pool with motorcycle observations
rationale: Vehicle economics are structurally different.

condition: customer-facing amount and driver gross earnings are separately defined
action_if_failed: otherwise keep fields separate and avoid bridge inference
rationale: Customer payment is not driver gross earnings.

condition: source identifies whether value is pre- or post-deduction and whether incentives/tips are included
action_if_failed: otherwise retain source label with caveat
rationale: Generic 'income' cannot be reclassified silently.

condition: tips separately identified where possible
action_if_failed: if bundled, record bundle and block core-earnings decomposition
rationale: Tips are not core service earnings.

condition: incentives/bonuses separately identified where possible
action_if_failed: if bundled, record bundle and caveat dependence analysis
rationale: Incentives may be temporary or conditional.

condition: expense is directly attributable to driving work
action_if_failed: otherwise exclude from operating-cost calculation
rationale: Household/personal consumption is not an operating cost.

condition: fuel expenditure directly observed or source-reported for matching work period
action_if_failed: retain as observed/source-reported fuel cost
rationale: Preferred over modelled fuel when definitions are adequate.

condition: compatible work-related distance, fuel efficiency, and fuel price are all explicit
action_if_failed: otherwise do not calculate
rationale: Modelled fuel must not fill unavailable observed values silently.

condition: fuel price matches product, period, and geography sufficiently for intended use
action_if_failed: otherwise scenario/caveat or not comparable
rationale: Fuel prices vary over time, product, and sometimes geography.

condition: total work-related distance is available
action_if_failed: if only paid-trip distance exists, require explicit caveat or scenario
rationale: Unpaid operating distance also consumes fuel and vehicle wear.

condition: online_hours > 0 and covers same population/activity period as numerator
action_if_failed: otherwise do not calculate net earnings per online hour
rationale: Online hours measure time commitment.

condition: productive_or_engaged_hours > 0 and definition matches numerator
action_if_failed: otherwise do not calculate productive-hour metric
rationale: Productive hours are not interchangeable with online hours.

condition: only ambiguous working_hours_source_reported is available
action_if_failed: retain source definition and do not relabel as online/productive
rationale: Hour semantics materially affect hourly earnings.

condition: order_count > 0 and numerator covers same period/service/population
action_if_failed: otherwise do not calculate
rationale: Numerator and denominator must be compatible.

condition: distance > 0 and numerator covers same activity/period
action_if_failed: prefer total_work_related_distance_km; caveat paid-trip-only basis
rationale: Paid distance understates operating exposure if unpaid km exist.

condition: depreciation is used for owned vehicle
action_if_failed: exclude financing principal from same economic-cost metric
rationale: Prevents capital-cost double counting.

condition: interest/fees separately measured when added to depreciation
action_if_failed: if not separable, do not infer interest from total installment
rationale: Principal and interest have different economic treatment.

condition: loan installment or principal cash outflow used in cash-flow view
action_if_failed: do not also deduct depreciation in same cash-flow metric
rationale: Cash-flow and economic-cost views must remain distinct.

condition: lease/rental payment represents vehicle access
action_if_failed: do not add driver-level depreciation for same vehicle use
rationale: Lease already represents access cost to driver.

condition: source reports installment without principal/interest split
action_if_failed: do not classify as depreciation or interest
rationale: Avoid unsupported decomposition.

condition: driver_side_platform_deduction and driver_gross_service_earnings are explicitly matched
action_if_failed: otherwise do not calculate realized deduction rate
rationale: Realized rate must use driver-side deduction basis.

condition: customer and driver amounts are transaction/definition matched
action_if_failed: label only as customer-to-driver gap
rationale: Gap can contain customer-side fees, insurance, promotions, taxes, or other components.

condition: source explicitly proves entire matched customer-to-driver gap is driver-side commission
action_if_failed: otherwise prohibited
rationale: Customer-to-driver gap is not automatically platform commission.

condition: authoritative legal text is accessible and exact scope/effective date/calculation basis are documented
action_if_failed: otherwise classify as announced/reported rule only
rationale: Legal benchmark requires the operative text, not only commentary.

condition: government/regulator states implementation status
action_if_failed: store separately from legal text and realized transactions
rationale: Implementation statement is a distinct evidence layer.

condition: platform publishes policy/implementation
action_if_failed: store separately from realized transaction evidence
rationale: Company statement does not prove universal realized application.

condition: driver or driver study reports deduction without transaction record
action_if_failed: preserve sampling and measurement limitations
rationale: Self-report is useful but not automatically nationally representative.

condition: legal/official reference and realized evidence share service, period, geography/scope, and calculation basis
action_if_failed: assign reconciliation status
rationale: Differences must be reconciled before interpretation.

condition: project has only economic/observational comparison
action_if_failed: use consistency/reconciliation language instead
rationale: Legal compliance determinations require legal analysis beyond a simple numeric comparison.

condition: source reports nominal IDR
action_if_failed: preserve original nominal value
rationale: Inflation adjustment must not overwrite source values.

condition: cross-period monetary comparison needs purchasing-power adjustment and compatible CPI is available
action_if_failed: document CPI series, geography, reference period, and formula
rationale: Real-value analysis is derived evidence.

condition: materially different periods are compared only in nominal terms
action_if_failed: prefer real adjustment where appropriate
rationale: Inflation can distort monetary comparisons.

condition: basic-needs/household prices are used
action_if_failed: keep outside driver operating costs
rationale: Household consumption is analytically separate from unit economics.

condition: researcher-created needs basket lacks explicit scenario justification/method
action_if_failed: do not present as welfare threshold
rationale: Avoid arbitrary adequacy conclusions.

condition: benchmark matches geography/period and conversion assumptions are explicit
action_if_failed: do not state legal underpayment from conversion alone
rationale: Minimum-wage benchmarks have specific legal definitions.

condition: official indicator definition and unit are compatible with intended affordability question
action_if_failed: do not subtract from driver operating earnings
rationale: Context benchmark is not an operating cost.

condition: economic concept, units, period/regime, geography, platform/service, vehicle, denominators, incentives/tips, sampling, and currency basis are materially aligned
action_if_failed: allow direct comparison
rationale: No material transformation or caveat required.

condition: difference can be reconciled with a transparent valid transformation without changing substantive meaning
action_if_failed: document formula and inputs
rationale: Transformation must be reproducible.

condition: comparison is informative but at least one material limitation remains
action_if_failed: state caveat in analysis and findings
rationale: Useful evidence can remain imperfect.

condition: evidence informs context but should not enter pooled metric/ranking
action_if_failed: exclude from pooled quantitative comparison
rationale: Prevents false precision.

condition: economic concept or denominator is materially incompatible and cannot be defensibly transformed
action_if_failed: do not pool or directly compare
rationale: Incompatibility is a valid finding.

condition: probability/representative design is documented for claimed population
action_if_failed: otherwise restrict inference to sample/coverage
rationale: Convenience/community samples are not national estimates.

condition: value unavailable
action_if_failed: preserve missing status; never replace with zero
rationale: Zero and unavailable are different states.

condition: interpolation/imputation/winsorization would be required to create observation
action_if_failed: do not perform silently; scenario only if explicitly justified
rationale: Preserve source evidence and uncertainty.

condition: value provenance is observed, source_reported, derived, modelled, or scenario
action_if_failed: block synthesis if unclassified
rationale: Findings must distinguish evidence from assumptions.

condition: all inputs, units, transformations, and formula are traceable
action_if_failed: otherwise fail calculation gate
rationale: Derived metrics must be reproducible.

condition: assumptions are explicit and separated from observed/source-reported evidence
action_if_failed: otherwise block scenario result
rationale: Scenarios must not masquerade as observations.

condition: all evidence supporting finding passes applicable critical gates
action_if_failed: otherwise caveat, contextualize, or mark unsupported
rationale: Findings come only from validated evidence.

condition: multiple relevant dimensions are validated and consistent enough for an overall statement
action_if_failed: otherwise report dimension-level findings only
rationale: Economic sustainability must not be predetermined or forced into one score.
